title: Summer shade and airflow retrofit
summary: Reduces indoor heat without blocking exits or trapping people.
content: Summer shade and airflow retrofit is a practical offline routine for heat shelter. Identify the coolest room by actual temperature, shade, night cooling, and safe airflow. Shade windows from the outside if safe because it stops sun before the glass. Use night flushing when outside air is cooler and daytime blocking when outside is hotter. Keep exits, stairs, and balcony doors usable during fire or earthquake. Set water, rest, and buddy checks for children, elderly people, workers, and heat-sensitive medicines.
